title: Bug: test_ntp.py runs ipv6_only twice for mgmt ipv6 only setup
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/20292/files#diff-3cfc4b06cc7ecc10aa8d5691584edaa14bb7e07d70319b3a116f50ebd7d5fb07

This PR forces IPv6 for IPv4 test case, but there is a IPv6 test case already, so it unnecessarily runs ipv6 case twice.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test_ntp.py in a mgmt ipv6 only setup

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

We should skip IPv4 test case for mgmt ipv6 only setup
